comparison.objective: Pull an anchor plate to a proof-load band while stabilizing it, hold, then ease off.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bracing, gradual force regulation, sustained load holding, and controlled unloading.
comparison.success_condition: Modeled spring travel reaches and holds the proof-load band for one second before easing back; exact numeric band limits are absent from the available body.
comparison.reason: Although both concern force regulation, proof loading tests sustained quasi-static tension. The candidate tests a transient hammer impulse, fracture at a manufactured notch, off-axis damage avoidance, and containment of detached parts.
